name: Saaras Mehan

education.notes: Cambridge CS undergrad. Patented a machine-learning algorithm at age 20. Former member of the England Chess Team.

keyDecisions: Founded Kular.ai in his early 20s; went through Y Combinator (W22-ish) — first founder reps before Jack & Jill.
Built and scaled Kular to 'significant revenue' (per public coverage).
lessons: A patented ML algorithm at 20 is the kind of artefact that converts Cambridge networks into a founder pipeline.
YC remains a legitimate UK→US route for technical founders without a US college credential.
careerSteps.notes: Kular.ai is an AI business-development team (sales / outbound AI). Public sources describe it as scaled to significant revenue; exact ARR not disclosed.

keyDecisions: Co-founded Jack & Jill AI (AI recruitment platform with agents for job seekers and businesses) with Matt Wilson in 2025.
Raised $20M seed led by Creandum within six months of founding — exceptional commercial validation pace.
Drew on the YC playbook + Kular's product velocity to ship Jack & Jill at speed.
lessons: Second-time founders compound — YC + Kular gave him the product discipline to scale Jack & Jill faster than a first venture.
AI-native recruitment is a wedge where the operator-pain (both founders frustrated by hiring at prior companies) maps directly onto product specs.
Tier-1 European VCs (Creandum) will write $20M cheques to repeat founders within six months — second-time velocity is real.
careerSteps.notes: Forbes 30 Under 30 Europe 2026 AI. Jack & Jill launched 2025; $20M Creandum-led seed October 2025.

outcomes.currentStatus: Co-Founder & CTO of Jack & Jill AI (UK). $20M seed (Creandum) October 2025 within six months of founding.

lessons.lesson: Cambridge CS + a patent at 20 + YC + a first venture scaled to revenue (Kular) is the cleanest UK-founder-pipeline template of the AI era.
lessons.source: Synthesised from Crunchbase, The Org, Forbes, Made in Shoreditch interview.

lessons.lesson: Second-time founder velocity is real — $20M seed within 6 months of founding only happens when the prior venture earned the network.
AI-native recruitment is an underserved wedge where the founder's own hiring frustration maps onto the product.
Extracurricular intensity (England Chess Team) is a credible signal of the operating temperament founder networks pattern-match on.
